entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material brought on record.

2. This second bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.490 of 2022, under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Tappal, District- Aligarh with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place on 02.05.2022.
The allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased levelled against the applicant are wholly false.
It is further submitted that during trial three witnesses have been examined and they have not supported the prosecution version and turned hostile.

Learned counsel Dinesh vs State Of U.P. on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179016094/
1 has referred statement of PW-1.Yogesh Kumar, who is brother of deceased, and PW-2 Mahesh and PW-3 Meena Devi, who are father and mother of the deceased, and stated that they have not supported prosecution version.
Lastly, it was stated that the applicant is in jail since 22.12.2022 and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and that deceased has suffered death due to smothering within a short period of six months of her marriage.
5. Perusal of record shows that applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place only about six months prior to the incident.
There are allegations that the deceased was harassed on account of dowry.
In postmortem report, nail marks have been shown at the neck of deceased and cause of death of deceased is antemortem smothering.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, no case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 9.12.2024 RKM  Dinesh vs State Of U.P. on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179016094/
